title: Gems of Bhutan: Thimphu, Punakha and Paro
alt: Whitewashed dzong walls above a Bhutanese river
transport: Private vehicle, driver and licensed guide throughout

stops.name: Thimphu
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel in the capital, walkable to the clock tower

activities.name: Local sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided half day of the town with your driver and guide, covering the main dzong, temple and market.

program.name: Thimphu
program.description: Days in the capital, with the Memorial Chorten, the Buddha Dordenma and Tashichho Dzong.

stops.name: Punakha
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Riverside hotel in the warm old winter capital

activities.name: Local sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided half day of the town with your driver and guide, covering the main dzong, temple and market.

program.name: Punakha
program.description: Time in the warm old winter capital, with the Dzong between two rivers and the suspension bridge.

stops.name: Paro
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Quiet hotel in the valley below Taktsang

activities.name: Paro sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided round of the valley with the National Museum, Rinpung Dzong and the ruins of Drukgyel Dzong.

activities.name: Hike to the Tiger's Nest
activities.description: The climb to Taktsang, the monastery wedged into a cliff nine hundred metres above the Paro valley floor.

program.name: Paro
program.description: Days in the valley below Taktsang, with Rinpung Dzong, the National Museum and the Tiger’s Nest hike.

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Fly in, three valleys, fly out. Five nights with every meal covered and nothing left for you to arrange.
expert.tip: Permits are handled for you, but carry two passport photographs anyway. Checkpoints inside the country still ask for them.

summary: 6 days through Thimphu, Punakha, Paro, with 5 nights, all meals and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the local sightseeing tour, the paro sightseeing tour, the hike to the tiger's nest.
included: Included: 5 nights across Thimphu, Punakha, Paro with all meals; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Local sightseeing tour; the Paro sightseeing tour; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
